comment: One 19x11 vero board with parts, and the bare cuts-and-links view below it. The regulator (pads A/O/I) and the TDA7240A amplifier (pads 1-7) mount on the board edge; IC1 is drawn rotated 180 degrees. Standby 1 / Standby 2 go to a standby switch whose type the drawing does not state; two wires, so entered as SPST. The two 1u are drawn as film capacitors, not cans.
uncertain: Standby switch: type not stated in the drawing, SPST assumed from the two wires
